text_block_list.text:
Lately, rumors of Biwa Hayahide's 
retirement have begun circulating among 
the public. Narita Brian is infuriated by 
the whispers.

She reflected on how her sister had been 
doing lately. And seeing that she still 
hadn't returned, she grew distressed, 
wondering if her sister had given up 
entirely.

However, when asked by her Trainer if that 
was truly the case, she remembered her 
sister's strength. In tears, she resolved 
to believe in her sister once more.

Meanwhile, Biwa Hayahide worked diligently 
on her rehab at the hospital. Refusing to 
give up, she aimed for a comeback.
